scripts.build: bun run embed:skills && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun run copy:assets
scripts.build:binary: bun run embed:skills && bun build src/cli/main.ts --compile --outfile dist/linearctl
scripts.copy:assets: mkdir -p dist/generated/manifest && cp src/generated/manifest/curated-commands.json dist/generated/manifest/curated-commands.json && cp src/generated/manifest/schema-meta.json dist/generated/manifest/schema-meta.json && (test -f src/generated/manifest/api-commands.json && cp src/generated/manifest/api-commands.json dist/generated/manifest/api-commands.json || true)
